meta.name: Hail Mary
meta.description: Hail Mary is a Malayalam drama-thriller following Madhu, an ordinary school bus driver in Kochi who is on the verge of starting a new life with Annie and her daughter, Hanna, until a resurfaced incident from the past shatters their peace. Set against the backdrop of everyday life in Kochi, their quiet hope for a fresh beginning is upended when the Kerala Police reopen a 23-year-old missing girl case. As buried secrets and old suspicions come to light, Madhu is pulled into an unexpected web of scrutiny, forcing him to protect the fragile new family he is trying to build while confronting the shadows of his past.
